methodology.signal: candidate list generated near/after signal-day close
methodology.execution: all buys and exits use next-session first 5-minute VWAP
methodology.portfolio: existing positions are never resized; exits create cash; new signals use only available cash
methodology.extension: after day 3, extend only when prior close >= entry*1.02, >= 3-close average and 2-session momentum > 0
methodology.max_holding: trend pullback: 8d if score>=85 else 6d; breakout pullback: 6d if score>=85 else 5d; critical breakout: 4d if score>=85 else 3d
methodology.hard_exit: prior close <= entry*0.95; executed next session open5 VWAP
methodology.early_exit: after >=2 sessions, prior close < entry*0.99 and <= previous close; executed next session open5 VWAP
methodology.repeated_signal: ignored while same stock is already held
methodology.equal_variant: available cash allocated equally among new candidates, capped at 15% of current NAV each
methodology.factor_variant: available cash allocated by (score-70)^2 * setup multiplier, capped at 15% of current NAV each
methodology.cash: left idle whenever candidate capacity is insufficient; no forced full investment
